title: The Estate at Gold Dust
description: Gorgeous 7 bed, 4.5 bath that sleeps 16 in a quiet neighborhood in the heart of the Scottsdale area, close to restaurants, nightlife, hiking, golf courses & spas, perfect for families, couples or guys/girls trips. Celebrity Greens putting green, heated pool, misted patio & fire pit. Upgraded kitchen, gym & game room w wet bar, billiards, pinball, Golden Tee & ping pong. A 3 bed, 2 bath remodeled casita is ideal for privacy & multi-family groups. WEDDINGS & SIMILAR EVENTS ARE STRICTLY PROHIBITED.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Private hot tub - available all year
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated
